extracted.intended_audience: Applicants for NIH K08/PHS 398 career development awards (NIH grant applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and completing a PHS 398 / K08 career development (resubmission) application, including budgets, human subjects/animal sections, required supplemental components, and responding to reviewer critiques in a resubmission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person budget entries
rubrics_metrics.description: List each Senior/Key Person with project role, base salary, calendar months, academic months, summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the total funds requested for all Senior/Key Persons; include additional Senior/Key Persons file if needed. Enter accurate calendar-month effort (e.g., PI 9.00 calendar months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel budget entries
rubrics_metrics.description: List number of personnel by role (Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical), calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total number of other personnel and total funds requested for Other Personnel; ensure reasonable justification in budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment listing requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each equipment item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a total funds requested for all listed equipment and attach additional equipment file if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs (domestic/foreign)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide funds requested separately for Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include travel justification within the budget justification; report totals in the appropriate budget sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Participant/Trainee costs including Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs must be shown; include justification for amounts and number of trainees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs categories
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs such as Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, and any other specified 'Other' categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for Other Direct Costs and justify major line items in the Budget Justification (e.g., RNA-Seq library prep, external hard drives, protein array materials).

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs total (A through F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sum of Direct Costs across budget categories A (Senior/Key Persons) through F (Other Direct Costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the Direct Costs total is correctly calculated and matches detailed line-item entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs (F&A) reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested for indirect costs (example: MTDC at 8.0%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide Cognizant Federal Agency contact (agency name, POC name, phone) and correctly apply institutional negotiated rates and bases (e.g., MTDC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report the sum of Total Direct Costs and Total Indirect Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify totals across budget pages and that indirect costs are applied to the correct base.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report any Fee requested separately in budget section J.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter fee amounts where allowed by FOA/institutional policy; otherwise report 0.00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification attachment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach one Budget Justification file explaining salary splits, effort, and the rationale for major budget items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only attach one file (e.g., K08_Budget-Justification_070516revised.pdf). The justification should explain institutional-based salary arrangements, list materials/supplies and key costs, and justify travel, equipment, and service line items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional-based salary certification
rubrics_metrics.description: When a PI receives salary from multiple institutional sources, certify that the two sources comprise a single compensation package and comply with NIH guidelines on institutional-based salary (NIH Notice NOT-OD-05-061).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not add duplicated calendar-month figures across salary sources to compute effort; the repeated figure reflects a split of one institutional-based salary and should not be summed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative budget totals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative totals for Sections A through J across the project period (salary, equipment, travel, participant costs, other direct costs, direct costs, indirect costs, total costs, fee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure consistency between per-period budgets and cumulative totals; include 0.00 for categories with no requested funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the project involves Human Subjects and whether it is a Clinical Trial and whether it is an Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer each question explicitly; if human subjects are involved, include Protection of Human Subjects documentation in the Research Plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are euthanized; if yes, state whether methods are consistent with AVMA guidelines; if not, describe method and provide scientific justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide appropriate detail in Vertebrate Animals section of Research Plan and justify deviations from AVMA guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether program income is anticipated for the budget periods requested (Yes/No); if Yes, list anticipated amount(s) and source(s) in the provided format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If program income is anticipated, fully report amounts and sources; leave blank if No.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells; if yes, list registry numbers of specific cell lines or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference the NIH hESC registry (http://grants.nih.gov/stem_cells/registry/current.htm) and include registration numbers or check the box if a specific line cannot yet be referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement: Inventions and Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether there are Inventions and Patents associated with the project and whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No and provide details for any inventions; include appropriate intellectual property disclosure as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: If changing Project Director/PI or grantee institution, provide names of former PD/PI or former institution and relevant change details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Change of Investigator/Institution section when applicable, following instructions for transfers or replacement of key personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Career Development application components
rubrics_metrics.description: The K08 (PHS 398 Career Development Award) supplemental form requires specified components: Introduction to Application (Resubmission), Candidate Information and Goals, Specific Aims, Research Strategy, Progress Report Publication List (for renewals), Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research, Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring, Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s), Letters of Support from Collaborators/Contributors/Consultants, Description of Institutional Environment, Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development, Protection of Human Subjects, Data Safety Monitoring Plan, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Inclusion of Children, Vertebrate Animals, Select Agent Research, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Resource Sharing, Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources, and Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide each item as a separate uploaded document where indicated; follow page limits and formatting rules in the FOA and PHS 398 instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Resubmission: addressing reviewers' critiques
rubrics_metrics.description: A resubmission must explicitly respond to prior reviewers' comments and describe how each critique has been addressed in the revised application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear narrative of changes made (e.g., combining aims, clarifying methods), and explain how revisions strengthen the application relative to prior review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity and rigor of computational and integrative methods
rubrics_metrics.description: The application must delineate how systems-biology approaches will be implemented to integrate epidemiological, clinical, genomic, and immunological data and how models will predict immune classes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe specific modeling approaches (e.g., regularized regression, machine learning), feature selection strategies, handling of mixed-type high-dimensional data, and testing of model accuracy (referenced as 3.2.2h in text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adequacy of statistical and epidemiological training
rubrics_metrics.description: The candidate's didactic training must provide sufficient statistical and epidemiological instruction to carry out proposed modeling and analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include formal courses, directed reading, and supervised analyses within the mentoring/training plan to show competence-building in modeling approaches and epidemiology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding arbitrary cut-offs and robust power/sample-size justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Decisions such as thresholds for defining outcomes (e.g., parasite density cut-offs) must be justified; power analyses should be robust and may include simulation-based estimates using actual sample counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain rationale for chosen cutoffs (e.g., lowering threshold from 2500 to 500 parasites/µl to increase sensitivity), and include simulation-based effect-size estimates and sample size calculations as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accounting for host genetic confounders
rubrics_metrics.description: Studies of malaria immunity must consider host genetic factors (e.g., HbS, HbC, ABO blood groups, α+-thalassemia, G6PD deficiency) that can protect against malaria and confound analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Either restrict study populations appropriately or incorporate these genetic variants into models to account for their effects; explicitly state how such variants are measured and included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Combining and integrating aims to avoid overlap
rubrics_metrics.description: Resubmissions should consider combining overlapping aims to streamline methods and improve integration between functional assays and high-dimensional data analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise aims structure when reviewers point out methodological overlaps; present a coherent plan that links aims and cross-validates results across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring relationships and institutional commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are evaluated on the quality of the mentoring team and the institution's commitment to the candidate's career development, including mentoring statements and letters of institutional support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide mentor plans/statements, letters of institutional commitment demonstrating protected time, resources, and concrete support for the candidate's development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstration of productivity and feasibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Candidates should show ongoing and planned projects, with realistic expectations for publications and productivity during the award period to allay reviewer concerns about reduced productivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List current collaborations and projects expected to yield publications; provide timelines and scope to demonstrate continuity of research output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear definitions of outcome groups (clinical vs sterile immunity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide robust, reproducible definitions and classification rules for outcome groups (e.g., clinically immune vs susceptible vs sterile immunity), including how indeterminate groups are handled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe criteria, thresholds, and rationales for class assignment; explain how indeterminate cases (e.g., children with 3 episodes) are categorized and used in analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-platform data integration and biologically informative feature selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Approaches should enable comparative, multi-platform analyses (gene expression, protein array, flow cytometry, functional assays) and use feature-selection methods that can select correlated groups of variables to derive biological insight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain specific analytical pipelines and how different data modalities will be harmonized and jointly analyzed to produce interpretable biological results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of key biological and chemical resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plan for authentication of key biological and/or chemical resources used in the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include documentation and procedures to verify identity and validity of reagents, cell lines, antibodies, etc., as required by PHS instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data/resource sharing plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Include data/resource sharing plans (e.g., Data Resource Sharing Plan) describing how data and materials generated will be shared.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specifics on timelines, repositories, and types of data to be shared consistent with NIH policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must include a plan for training the candidate (and any trainees) in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe course work, mentoring, and experiential components; indicate duration and frequency as required by NIH guidelines.
